as_told.title: 1949 emergency meeting on UFOs and nukes at Killeen base

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says declassified documents show that in 1949, after several sightings over Killeen Base at Camp Hood, an army post in Texas that he says held America's largest nuclear weapons stockpile at the time, an emergency meeting was called. In a later episode he credits the story to researcher Robert Hastings' book UFOs and Nukes and is less sure of the year. If true, it would mean unknown objects were taking an interest in American nuclear weapons from early on.
